overview.text: He advanced a proposal to let voters decide on a 3% surtax on income over $1 million, directing the revenue to schools and property tax relief. He voted for a state law regulating the cryptocurrency industry. As chair of the Illinois Firearm Task Force, he has advocated for stronger enforcement against illegal gun trafficking and investments in community violence prevention. At a candidate forum, he said he would form a task force to protect seniors' Medicare and raise Social Security benefits. He has also urged the establishment of an overdose prevention site on Chicago’s West Side.
